_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

I've created a full data dictionary for the Unity database at **`DATA-DICTIONARY.md`** in your project root.

## What's in it

**103 tables** and **864 columns**, written for a non-technical audience:

| Section | What it covers |
|---------|----------------|
| **Getting started** | Explains tables, columns, and key app ↔ database terms (Patient = child, AdminUser = staff) |
| **Quick reference** | One-page summary of every table grouped by business area |
| **Detailed sections** | Every column with plain-English meaning and simplified data type |
| **Glossary** | DP-3, ISAA, REELS, SPM, FSP, FNP, IFSP, CMS |

## How it's organized

Tables are grouped into 14 business areas instead of alphabetical order:

1. **Centres & locations** — Centre, State, City  
2. **Staff & clinicians** — AdminUser, roles, centre assignments, login history  
3. **CMS administrators** — Content portal users  
4. **Children & families** — Patient, parents, case notes, audit log  
5. **Assessment assignments** — AllocatePatient, reports, files  
6. **DP-3 / ISAA / REELS / SPM** — Each assessment type, split into child records vs master templates  
7. **Family Service Plan** — Goals, objectives, interventions, tools  
8. **Goal approvals** — Manager approval workflow  
9. **Content library** — Videos, games, files, tags  

## Example entry

For the **Patient** (child) table:

| Column | What it means | Type |
|--------|---------------|------|
| **Patient ID** | Human-readable child ID shown in the app | Text |
| **Date Of Birth** | Date of birth | Date only |
| **Diagnosis** | Clinical diagnosis information | Text |
| **Centre ID** | Links to the therapy centre | Whole number |

## Keeping it up to date

A generator script **`generate-data-dictionary.js`** reads from your existing `schema-dump.txt` and rebuilds the dictionary. After a schema change:

```powershell
node check-schema.js          # refresh schema dump from Azure SQL
node generate-data-dictionary.js   # regenerate the dictionary
```

---

The file is ~127 KB of markdown — long, but scannable via the table of contents and category summaries at the top. If you want, I can also produce a **shorter executive summary** (e.g. top 20 tables only) or export it to **PDF/Word** for sharing with stakeholders.

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "    const pool = await poolPromise;"
          },

            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "    const dateFilter = buildDateFilter('pal.CreatedDateTime', '@dateFrom', '@dateTo');"

          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    const centreFilter = '(@centreId IS NULL OR c.Id = @centreId)';"

          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 590,
            "text": "async function buildSummaryQuery(pool, role, ctx) {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 591,
            "text": "  const { userId, centreId, dateFrom, dateTo, centreExclusion, dateFilterPal, cpf, cpfPt } = ctx;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 592
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 593,
            "text": "  if (role === 'clinician') {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 594,
            "text": "    return bindCommon(pool.request(), { userId, centreId, dateFrom, dateTo }).query(&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 595,
            "text": "      SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 596,
            "text": "        ISNULL(rs.resultsGenerated, 0) AS resultsGenerated,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 597,
            "text": "        ISNULL(cs.activeCaseload, 0)   AS activeCaseload,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 598,
            "text": "        ISNULL(act.totalAuditActions, 0) AS totalAuditActions,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 599,
            "text": "        ISNULL(act.activeDays, 0) AS activeDays,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 600,
            "text": "        tat.avgTimeToResultHours,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 601,
            "text": "        ISNULL(stuck.stuckCases, 0) AS stuckCases"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 602,
            "text": "      FROM AdminUser au"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 603,
            "text": "      OUTER APPLY ("
          },
          {

            "text": "        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pal2.Id) AS resultsGenerated"
          },
          {

            "text": "        FROM PatientAuditLog pal2"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 606,
            "text": "        JOIN AllocatePatient ap ON ap.PatientId = pal2.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 607,
            "text": "        JOIN Patient pt         ON pt.Id = pal2.PatientId"
          },

            "text": "  if (role === 'manager') {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 677,
            "text": "    return bindCommon(pool.request(), { userId, centreId, dateFrom, dateTo }).query(&#96;"
          },

            "lineNumber": 678,
            "text": "      SELECT"

            "lineNumber": 679,
            "text": "        SUM(CASE WHEN pal.Type = 'CaseRegistered' AND ${cpf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS casesRegistered,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 680,
            "text": "        SUM(CASE WHEN pal.Type = 'CaseAssigned'   AND ${cpf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assessmentsAssigned,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 681,
            "text": "        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Id IS NOT NULL AND ${cpf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalActions,"
          },
          {

            "text": "        ISNULL(stuck.stuckOnboarding, 0) AS stuckOnboarding,"
          },

            "text": "        onboard.avgOnboardingHours,"

            "text": "        ISNULL(xfers.statusChanges, 0) AS statusChanges"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 686,
            "text": "      FROM AdminUser au"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 687,
            "text": "      LEFT JOIN PatientAuditLog pal ON pal.AdminUserId = au.Id AND ${dateFilterPal}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 688,
            "text": "      LEFT JOIN Patient p ON p.Id = pal.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 689,
            "text": "      LEFT JOIN Centre c  ON c.Id = p.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 690,
            "text": "      OUTER APPLY ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 691,
            "text": "        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pal_reg.PatientId) AS stuckOnboarding"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 692,
            "text": "        FROM PatientAuditLog pal_reg"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 693,
            "text": "        JOIN Patient pt ON pt.Id = pal_reg.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 694,
            "text": "        WHERE pal_reg.AdminUserId = au.Id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 695,
            "text": "          AND pal_reg.Type = 'CaseRegistered'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 696,
            "text": "          AND pal_reg.CreatedDateTime \u003c DATEADD(hour, -48, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET())"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 697,
            "text": "          AND ${cpfPt.replace(/\\bpt\\b/g, 'pt')}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 698,
            "text": "          AND NOT EXISTS ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 699,
            "text": "            SELECT 1 FROM PatientAuditLog p2"

          {

            "text": "            WHERE p2.PatientId = pal_reg.PatientId AND p2.Type = 'CaseAssigned'"
          },
          {

            "text": "          )"

            "lineNumber": 702,
            "text": "      ) stuck"
          },
          {

            "text": "      OUTER APPLY ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 704,
            "text": "        SELECT AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(minute, r.registeredAt, a.assignedAt) AS FLOAT) / 60.0) AS avgOnboardingHours"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 705,
            "text": "        FROM ("

          {
            "lineNumber": 706,
            "text": "          SELECT pal.PatientId, MIN(pal.CreatedDateTime) AS registeredAt"

          {
            "lineNumber": 707,
            "text": "          FROM PatientAuditLog pal"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 708,
            "text": "          JOIN Patient pt ON pt.Id = pal.PatientId"
          },

            "text": "          WHERE pal.AdminUserId = au.Id AND pal.Type = 'CaseRegistered' AND ${cpfPt}"

          {

            "text": "          GROUP BY pal.PatientId"

          {

            "text": "          FROM PatientAuditLog pal"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 715,
            "text": "          WHERE pal.Type = 'CaseAssigned'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 716,
            "text": "          GROUP BY pal.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 717,
            "text": "        ) a ON a.PatientId = r.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 718,
            "text": "        WHERE a.assignedAt \u003e r.registeredAt"
          },
          {

            "text": "      ) onboard"

          {

            "text": "      OUTER APPLY ("

          {

            "text": "        SELECT"
          },

          },
          {

            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN pal.Type = 'CaseStatusChanged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusChanges"
          },
          {

            "text": "        FROM PatientAuditLog pal"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 725,
            "text": "        LEFT JOIN Patient p ON p.Id = pal.PatientId"
          },
          {

            "text": "        WHERE pal.AdminUserId = au.Id"

          {
            "lineNumber": 727,
            "text": "          AND pal.Type IN ('CaseTransfer', 'CaseStatusChanged')"

          {
            "lineNumber": 728,
            "text": "          AND "

          },

            "text": "      // Q2: cases stuck in onboarding (registered \u003e 48 h ago, never assigned)"

          },

            "text": "      // Q3: pending goal approvals (not approved or rejected) — centre filter only"

            "text": "        WHERE pgarg.Status NOT IN ('Approved', 'Rejected')"

            "isSignature": true,

            "text": "async function queryFunnelStage(ctx, auditType, categoryLabel) {"
          },

            "text": "  const { bindAll, centreJoin, centreFilter, centreExclusion, dateFilterPal, patientNameExpr } = ctx;"

            "text": "  const result = await bindAll(pool.request()).query(&#96;"

            "text": "    SELECT TOP (${MAX_ITEMS})"

            "text": "      pt.Id AS patientId,"
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "      c.Id AS centreId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 398,
            "text": "      c.CentreName AS centreName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 399,
            "text": "      MIN(pal.CreatedDateTime) AS eventAt,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 400,
            "text": "      NULL AS waitingHours,"
          },
          {

            "text": "      '${auditType}' AS status,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402,
            "text": "      NULL AS detail"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 403,
            "text": "    FROM PatientAuditLog pal"

            "text": "      AND ${dateFilterPal}"

            "text": "    GROUP BY pt.Id, pt.PatientID, pt.FirstName, pt.LastName, c.Id, c.CentreName"

          {
            "lineNumber": 410,
            "text": "    ORDER BY eventAt DESC"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 411,
            "text": "  &#96;);"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 412,
            "text": "  return result.recordset.map(mapPatientRow);"

            "text": "const QUERY_HANDLERS = {"

          },

            "text": "  'status-changes': (ctx) =\u003e queryAuditEvents(ctx, 'CaseStatusChanged', 'Status change'),"

            "text": "  'transfers': (ctx) =\u003e queryAuditEvents(ctx, 'CaseTransfer', 'Transfer'),"
          },

            "text": "  'funnel-registered': (ctx) =\u003e queryFunnelStage(ctx, 'CaseRegistered', 'Registered'),"
          },
          {

            "text": "  'funnel-assigned': (ctx) =\u003e queryFunnelStage(ctx, 'CaseAssigned', 'Assigned'),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 560,
            "text": "  'funnel-results': (ctx) =\u003e queryFunnelStage(ctx, 'ReportPDFGenerated', 'Result generated'),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 561,
            "text": "  'funnel-goals-approved': queryFunnelGoalsApproved,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 562,
            "text": "  'weekly-onboarding': queryWeeklyOnboarding,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 563,
            "text": "  'weekly-goal-approval': queryWeeklyGoalApproval,"
          },
          {

            "text": "  'centre-severity': queryCentreSeverity,"
          },

            "text": "};"

            "lineNumber": 566
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 567,
            "text": "/**"

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 590,
            "text": "async function buildSummaryQuery(pool, role, ctx) {"

          {
            "lineNumber": 677
          },

            "text": "&#96;);"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 734,
            "text": "  }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 735
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 736,
            "text": "  // centre-admin"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 737,
            "text": "  return bindCommon(pool.request(), { userId, centreId, dateFrom, dateTo }).query(&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 738,
            "text": "    SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 739,
            "text": "      SUM(CASE WHEN pal.Type = 'CaseRegistered' AND ${cpf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS casesRegistered,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 740,
            "text": "      SUM(CASE WHEN pal.Type = 'CaseAssigned'   AND ${cpf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS casesAssignedToClinical,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 741,
            "text": "      SUM(CASE WHEN p.Id IS NOT NULL AND ${cpf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalActions,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 742,
            "text": "      route.avgRoutingHours,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 743,
            "text": "      ISNULL(sameDay.sameDayRoutingPct, 0) AS sameDayRoutingPct"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 744,
            "text": "    FROM AdminUser au"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 745,
            "text": "    LEFT JOIN PatientAuditLog pal ON pal.AdminUserId = au.Id AND ${dateFilterPal}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 746,
            "text": "    LEFT JOIN Patient p ON p.Id = pal.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 747,
            "text": "    LEFT JOIN Centre c  ON c.Id = p.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 748,
            "text": "    OUTER APPLY ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 749,
            "text": "      SELECT AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(minute, r.registeredAt, a.assignedAt) AS FLOAT) / 60.0) AS avgRoutingHours"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 750,
            "text": "      FROM ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 751,
            "text": "        SELECT pal.PatientId, MIN(pal.CreatedDateTime) AS registeredAt"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 752,
            "text": "        FROM PatientAuditLog pal"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 753,
            "text": "        JOIN Patient pt ON pt.Id = pal.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 754,
            "text": "        WHERE pal.AdminUserId = au.Id AND pal.Type = 'CaseRegistered' AND ${cpfPt}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 755,
            "text": "        GROUP BY pal.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 756,
            "text": "      ) r"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 757,
            "text": "      JOIN ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 758,
            "text": "        SELECT pal.PatientId, MIN(pal.CreatedDateTime) AS assignedAt"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 759,
            "text": "        FROM PatientAuditLog pal"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 760,
            "text": "        WHERE pal.Type = 'CaseAssigned'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 761,
            "text": "        GROUP BY pal.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 762,
            "text": "      ) a ON a.PatientId = r.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 763,
            "text": "      WHERE a.assignedAt \u003e r.registeredAt"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 764,
            "text": "    ) route"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 765,
            "text": "    OUTER APPLY ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 766,
            "text": "      SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 767,
            "text": "        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 768,
            "text": "        ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(hour, r.registeredAt, a.assignedAt) \u003c= 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 769,
            "text": "             / COUNT(*) * 100"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 770,
            "text": "        END AS sameDayRoutingPct"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 771,
            "text": "      FROM ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 772,
            "text": "        SELECT pal.PatientId, MIN(pal.CreatedDateTime) AS registeredAt"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 773,
            "text": "        FROM PatientAuditLog pal"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 774,
            "text": "        JOIN Patient pt ON pt.Id = pal.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 775,
            "text": "        WHERE pal.AdminUserId = au.Id AND pal.Type = 'CaseRegistered' AND ${cpfPt}"
          },
